# Auralis Jewelry

> Quote-first custom crystal bracelet and gemstone jewelry service. Customers share a budget and preferences before Auralis recommends ready-to-ship, simple-personalization or fully custom directions.

## Core facts
- Website: https://auralisgems.com/
- Contact: hello@auralisgems.com
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/8618357590167
- Full custom requests generally start around US$60 and can reach several hundred dollars.
- Ready-to-ship designs are individually priced and may be below or above US$60.
- Fully custom designs include up to two reasonable revisions before production.
- A 30% deposit is required after design direction and quote confirmation.
- Typical production is approximately 5–14 days after confirmation and deposit.
- A standalone Chinese Five Elements reading is available for US$13.50 for cultural interest and personal reflection.
- No blanket claim is made that every stone is untreated, certified or 100% natural.

## Ordering principle
Tell Auralis your budget, color or style direction, wrist size, purpose, quantity and delivery country. Auralis reviews available materials and styles, recommends a direction and confirms the quote before payment.
